'''Otoforli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] merchant who lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Otoforli lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he worked in the [[Senate Commercial District|Commerce Hall]] below the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Otoforli appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a specialty goods vendor on Coruscant.
